mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined for at least 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending power and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances where UNRATE has exceeded 4.5% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which triggers a sell-off in equities as corporate revenue expectations are revised downward, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 55% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of manufacturing contraction (INDPRO below 100), industrial output slowdowns signal reduced corporate capacity utilization and lower profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO is below 100.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflationary pressures that prompt the Federal Reserve to maintain restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0% year-over-year.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS has increased for at least 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 2000 thousand units, it reflects strong consumer confidence and construction activity, which supports economic growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST exceeds 2000.0.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing output and capacity utilization, which signals stronger corporate profits and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO has increased for at least 3 consecutive months.
